info.title: Together APIs
info.description: The Together REST API. See https://docs.together.ai for more details.

get.description: Lists endpoints shared with every project in the specified organization. Project-private and public endpoints are not included.

schema.description: Maximum number of results to return.
Cursor from a previous list response.
Sort field for the results. Supports `created_at` or `updated_at`, optionally followed by `asc` or `desc`.

Filter expression using `name`, `created_at`, or `updated_at` with comparison operators and AND/OR/NOT; timestamps must be RFC 3339 strings. `name` supports substring matching with `:` and prefix/suffix wildcards with `*`, and must be a bare endpoint name.

get.description: Lists custom models shared with every project in the specified organization. Project-private and public models are not included.

schema.description: Maximum number of results to return.
Cursor from a previous list response.

get.description: Lists production-ready configuration revisions compatible with a reference model. Specify the model with `referenceModel` or the deprecated `referenceModelId`; if both are supplied, they must identify the same model. Results include public configurations and configurations owned by the specified project.

schema.description: Deprecated. Use `referenceModel`. Reference model identifier filter; if both are set, they must agree.
Model resource-name filter using `projects/{projectId}/models/{modelId}`; alternative to `referenceModelId`. If both are set, they must agree.
Maximum number of results to return.
Cursor from a previous list response.

get.description: Retrieves a model configuration revision by ID, including its runtime selectors and certifications.
Lists the dedicated inference endpoints owned by the specified project.

schema.description: Maximum number of endpoints to return.
Sort field for the results. Supports `created_at` or `updated_at`, optionally followed by `asc` or `desc`.

Filter expression using `name`, `created_at`, or `updated_at` with comparison operators and AND/OR/NOT; timestamps must be RFC 3339 strings. `name` supports substring matching with `:` and prefix/suffix wildcards with `*`, and accepts a bare endpoint name or `<project_slug>/<endpoint_name>`.

post.description: Creates a stable, inference-addressable endpoint. Add one or more deployments and configure its traffic split before sending inference requests to the endpoint name.

patch.description: Updates mutable endpoint fields such as its endpoint string, visibility, or deployment traffic split. Use `updateMask` to select fields explicitly and `etag` in the request body for optimistic concurrency.

schema.description: Fields to update. If not set, the fields populated are updated.

get.description: Retrieves an endpoint and lightweight summaries of the deployments attached to it.

delete.description: Permanently deletes an endpoint. Delete its deployments first; use `etag` to reject the request if the endpoint changed after it was read.

schema.description: Etag for optimistic concurrency. If set, the delete is rejected if the current etag does not match.

get.description: Lists the deployments attached to an endpoint, including their model, configuration, scaling settings, placement, and current status.

schema.description: ID of the project that owns the endpoint.
ID of the endpoint whose deployments are listed.
Maximum number of deployments to return. Max 500, defaults to 50.
Cursor from a previous deployment list response.
Sort field for the results. Supports `created_at` or `updated_at`, optionally followed by `asc` or `desc`.

Filter expression using `name`, `state`, `model`, `created_at`, or `updated_at` with comparison operators and AND/OR/NOT; `state` takes a DeploymentState enum name and `model` takes a model resource name. `name` supports substring matching with `:` and prefix/suffix wildcards with `*`, and accepts a bare deployment name or `<project_slug>/<endpoint_name>/<deployment_name>`.

post.description: Creates a model deployment under an endpoint. The deployment provisions asynchronously; monitor its status before routing live traffic to it.

schema.description: ID of the project that owns the endpoint.
ID of the endpoint that will contain the deployment.
When true, validates the request without creating or provisioning a deployment.

patch.description: Updates mutable deployment fields such as its model, configuration, autoscaling bounds, or LoRA support. Changes that affect serving may trigger asynchronous reprovisioning.

schema.description: Fields to update. If not set, the fields populated on `deployment` are updated.

get.description: Retrieves a deployment's desired configuration, placement, runtime information, and current provisioning status.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a deployment from its endpoint. Remove the deployment from live traffic first; use `etag` to reject the request if it changed after it was read.

schema.description: Etag for optimistic concurrency. If set, the delete is rejected if the current etag does not match.

get.description: Lists LoRA adapters attached to a deployment with per-cluster load state.

schema.description: Maximum number of adapters to return.
Cursor from a previous adapter list response.

post.description: Attaches a LoRA adapter to a deployment. If the deployment is at adapter capacity, force can evict the oldest adapter.

get.description: Gets an attached adapter and its per-cluster load state.

delete.description: Detaches an adapter from a deployment using its row-level etag for optimistic concurrency.

schema.description: Adapter etag from a previous add, update, get, or list response. The removal is rejected if the adapter changed after that response.

patch.description: Updates the pinned revision of an attached adapter using its row-level etag for optimistic concurrency.

get.description: Lists rollout histories for an endpoint. Use `filter=ROLLOUT_FILTER_ACTIVE` to return only the active rollout, if one exists.

schema.description: Maximum number of rollouts to return. Max 500, defaults to 50.
Cursor from a previous rollout list response.
Narrow results to active or terminal rollouts. Omit to list all rollouts.

post.description: Creates a rollout in the pending state without shifting traffic. Start the rollout in a separate request after reviewing its strategy and metric gates.

canary.summary: Canary rollout with a metric gate

post.description: Returns the values a create request would pick for any field left unset, plus the capacity context needed to display them, without creating a rollout. Responses are display state only and re-validated authoritatively at create and start; do not copy response values back into a create request.

get.description: Retrieves a rollout's strategy, lifecycle state, current traffic percentage, step history, and metric-gate results.

delete.description: Deletes a rollout record. An active rollout must be aborted or completed before it can be deleted.

post.description: Starts a pending rollout and begins its configured traffic-shifting workflow.
Requests a running or stabilizing rollout to pause and records an optional reason. The response returns the PAUSING snapshot; poll GetRollout until state is PAUSED to confirm the executor has parked.
Resumes a pausing, paused, or system-paused rollout from its current step and traffic split.

Cancels a running, pausing, paused, system-paused, or stabilizing rollout by freezing the current traffic split into standing weights. Revert is removed and rejected; after canceling, start another canary rollout in either direction or rebalance the traffic split. The response is the accepted rollout snapshot; poll GetRollout until it reaches CANCELED.
Completes a running or paused rollout immediately by sending all live traffic to the target deployment.

get.description: Lists the managed live-traffic experiments configured for an endpoint.

schema.description: Maximum number of A/B experiments to return. Max 500, defaults to 50.
Cursor from a previous A/B experiment list response.

post.description: Creates a managed control/variant split across two to 20 deployments under the same endpoint. Exactly one member is the control, member percentages must add up to 100, and the split applies only to traffic that the endpoint would otherwise send to the control.

patch.description: Updates an experiment's description or member traffic percentages. Use the experiment etag for optimistic concurrency.

schema.description: Fields to update. If omitted, all mutable fields are overwritten.

get.description: Retrieves an A/B experiment and its participating deployments, roles, and traffic percentages.

delete.description: Deletes an A/B experiment and removes its managed traffic split. The deployments themselves are not deleted.

schema.description: Etag for optimistic concurrency. If set, the delete is rejected if the current etag does not match.

get.description: Lists experiments that mirror sampled endpoint traffic to target deployments without affecting client responses. Set `includeTargets=true` to include target details inline.

schema.description: Maximum number of shadow experiments to return. Max 500, defaults to 50.
Cursor from a previous shadow experiment list response.
Whether to include target deployments in each returned shadow experiment.

post.description: Creates an experiment that mirrors a sampled portion of endpoint traffic to one or more target deployments without returning their responses to clients. Add a description with the update operation after creation.

patch.description: Updates a shadow experiment's description or source sampling strategy. `updateMask` is required; source changes also require the current `etag` in the request body.

schema.description: Required fields to update, such as description or source.

get.description: Retrieves a shadow experiment, including its sampling strategy and target deployments.

delete.description: Deletes a shadow experiment and its target records. The underlying deployments are not deleted.

get.description: Lists the deployments that receive mirrored requests from a shadow experiment.

schema.description: Maximum number of targets to return. Max 500, defaults to 50.
Cursor from a previous shadow experiment target list response.

post.description: Adds a deployment under the same endpoint as a target for mirrored requests.

patch.description: Updates a shadow target's name, deployment, or description. `updateMask` is required and must select at least one mutable field.

schema.description: Comma-separated fields to update. Supported fields are `name`, `targetDeploymentId`, and `description`.

get.description: Retrieves one target configured to receive mirrored requests from a shadow experiment.

delete.description: Removes a target from a shadow experiment without deleting the underlying deployment.

get.description: Returns aggregated request, token, latency, throughput, error, and resource-utilization metrics for an endpoint over a time range. Optionally includes time-series buckets and a per-deployment breakdown.

schema.description: Restrict to a single deployment under this endpoint.
Inclusive start of the time range. Defaults to 24 hours ago if unset.
Exclusive end of the time range. Defaults to now if unset.
When true, include per-bucket time series in the response.
Time-series bucket duration, such as `1m`, `1h`, or `1d`. Defaults to `1d`.

get.description: Lists an endpoint's audit and lifecycle events newest first. The feed combines endpoint changes with provisioning, scaling, readiness, rollout, and other events from deployments under the endpoint.

schema.description: Maximum number of events to return. Max 10000, defaults to 50.
Cursor from a previous endpoint event list response.
Event types to include, such as `deployment.scaled` or `condition.set`. Combined with other filters using AND.
Minimum severity. Omit to disable severity filtering.
Return only events at or after this time.
Return only events strictly before this time.

Deployment IDs whose events should be included. Every ID must belong to the endpoint. Supplying this filter excludes endpoint-scoped events unless `SOURCE_KIND_ENDPOINT` is also included in `sourceKinds`.
Resource kinds whose events should be included. Omit to include both endpoint- and deployment-scoped events.
ID of a subject associated with the event, such as a rollout. Combined with other filters using AND.

get.description: Lists custom model resources owned by the specified project. Use the organization endpoint to list models shared across projects or the supported-model catalog to discover Together-hosted base models.

schema.description: Model visibility. Private means it is scoped to the project. Internal means it is scoped to the organization.
Organization whose shared models should be included. Defaults to the authenticated project's organization.
Maximum number of models to return.
Cursor from a previous model list response.

post.description: Registers a custom model resource in the project. Registration creates the model's metadata; upload or import model files separately before deploying it.

get.description: Retrieves a custom model's metadata, visibility, weight information, and base-model relationship.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a custom model resource. The model must not be in use by an active deployment.

schema.description: ID of the project that owns the model.

patch.description: Updates mutable model metadata such as its inference name, description, base model, or visibility.

schema.description: Fields to update. If omitted, all mutable fields are overwritten.

get.description: Lists reusable, project-visible placement policies that control the regions where deployments may be scheduled.

schema.description: Maximum number of profiles to return. Max 500, defaults to 50.
Cursor from a previous placement profile list response.

get.description: Retrieves a reusable placement profile and its ordered region preferences.
Lists files in the latest or specified revision of a model, including paths, sizes, and content hashes.
Lists the immutable file revisions available for a custom model, newest first.
Retrieves metadata for one immutable revision of a custom model's files.
Lists asynchronous jobs that import model files from Hugging Face or a presigned remote URL.

schema.description: Maximum number of uploads to return.
Cursor from a previous remote upload list response.

post.description: Starts an asynchronous job that imports model files from Hugging Face or a presigned URL into a registered model and creates a model revision when the import completes.

get.description: Retrieves the status, progress details, retry counts, and timestamps for a remote model import job.
Lists progress and diagnostic events for a remote model import job.

schema.description: Maximum number of events to return.
Cursor from a previous remote upload event list response.

get.description: Lists endpoints that are publicly visible across Together projects.

schema.description: Maximum number of results to return.
Cursor from a previous list response.
Sort field for the results. Supports `created_at` or `updated_at`, optionally followed by `asc` or `desc`.

Filter expression using `name`, `created_at`, or `updated_at` with comparison operators and AND/OR/NOT; timestamps must be RFC 3339 strings. `name` supports substring matching with `:` and prefix/suffix wildcards with `*`, and must be a bare endpoint name.

get.description: Lists hardware instance types currently available to inference deployments, including GPU resources, pricing, regions, and best-effort capacity headroom.
Retrieves the GPU resources, pricing, regional availability, and best-effort capacity headroom for one inference instance type.
Lists Together-hosted base models that can be deployed for dedicated inference, together with their capabilities and certified deployment profiles.

schema.description: Case-insensitive search across model IDs, names, and descriptions.
Maximum number of models to return.
Cursor from a previous supported-model list response.

get.description: Retrieves a Together-hosted base model and the certified model, configuration, hardware, and performance profiles available for deployment.
Fetch video metadata

x-codeSamples.label: Together AI SDK (Python)
x-codeSamples.source:
from together import Together
import os

client = Together(
    api_key=os.environ.get("TOGETHER_API_KEY"),
)

response = client.videos.retrieve(video_id)

print(response.id)

import os

)

DE.Endpoint.description: Stable inference entry point that groups deployments and routes requests among them.

projectId.description: ID of the project that owns the endpoint.

name.description:
Project-qualified endpoint name in the form `<project_slug>/<endpoint_name>`.
Pass this value as `model` in inference requests. Create and update requests
may use either a bare endpoint name or the qualified form; a supplied project
slug must match the project in the request path.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the endpoint was created.

updatedAt.description: Output only. Timestamp when the endpoint was last updated.

etag.description:
Opaque version tag for optimistic concurrency control.
Supply on update/delete to ensure consistent read-modify-write.
If not set, the write overwrites based on current state.

trafficSplit.description: Deployments eligible for live traffic and their capacity weights. An empty list leaves the endpoint unrouted.

visibility.description: Who can discover the endpoint. `VISIBILITY_PRIVATE` restricts it to the project; `VISIBILITY_INTERNAL` shares it with the organization.

endpointType.description: Serving class of the endpoint. Reserved endpoints use reserved capacity.

deployments.description:
Lightweight summaries of deployments under this endpoint.
Retrieve a deployment through the endpoint's deployment API for full details.

activeRolloutId.description: ID of the currently active rollout in an in-flight state, including paused.

DE.DeploymentSummary.description: Compact deployment status embedded in an endpoint response.

modelId.description: Deprecated. Use `model`. Model identifier being served.

hardware.description: Hardware configuration selected by the deployment's config, such as its GPU type and count.

trafficMode.description: Whether the deployment serves client-visible responses or only mirrored shadow traffic.

name.description:
Inference-addressable name in the fully-qualified form
"<project_slug>/<endpoint_name>/<deployment_name>". Pass it as the
"model" field when calling the inference API to pin to this deployment.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the deployment was created.

desiredReplicas.description: Number of replicas the autoscaler currently wants across all regions.

readyReplicas.description: Number of replicas currently ready to serve requests across all regions.

model.description:
Resource name of the served model in the form
`projects/{projectId}/models/{modelId}/revisions/{revisionId}`.
For public models, the model's owning project may differ from the deployment's project.

estimatedEffectiveTrafficShare.description: Estimated fraction from 0 to 1 of endpoint traffic currently routed to this deployment.

DE.TrafficSplitEntry.description: Capacity weight assigned to one deployment in an endpoint's live traffic split.

deploymentId.description: ID of a deployment under the endpoint that can receive live traffic.

weight.description:
Non-negative, finite weight applied to each ready replica. A deployment's
effective routing capacity is `weight * readyReplicas`, and requests are
distributed in proportion to that capacity. Set to `0` to remove the
deployment from the live traffic split.

DE.CreateEndpointRequest.description: Request parameters for creating an endpoint.

name.description: Inference-addressable endpoint name to create.

visibility.description: Who can discover the endpoint. `VISIBILITY_PRIVATE` restricts it to the project; `VISIBILITY_INTERNAL` shares it with the organization.

name.description: Updated endpoint string.

etag.description: Current endpoint version. The update is rejected if this value no longer matches.

visibility.description: Who can discover the endpoint. `VISIBILITY_PRIVATE` restricts it to the project; `VISIBILITY_INTERNAL` shares it with the organization.

placement.description: Placement policy to use when scheduling the deployment.

projectId.description: ID of the project that owns the deployment.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the deployment was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the deployment was last updated.

modelId.description: Deprecated. Use `model`. Model identifier being served, populated during migration.

trafficMode.description: Whether the deployment serves client-visible responses or only mirrored shadow traffic.

DE.AddAdapterRequest.description: Configuration for attaching a LoRA adapter to a deployment that has adapter loading enabled.

adapterRevisionId.description: Optional adapter revision to pin. If omitted, the latest revision is resolved at request time.

force.description: Whether to evict the oldest adapter if the deployment is at adapter capacity.

DE.ListRolloutsResponse.description: Response containing rollout resources and pagination metadata.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Null if there are no more results.

DE.CreateRolloutRequest.description: Strategy, metric gates, timing, and cleanup policy for shifting traffic between two deployments under one endpoint.

sourceDeploymentId.description: Deployment that traffic shifts away from.

canary.description: Canary rollout strategy configuration. Mutually exclusive with blueGreen and rolling.

blueGreen.description: Blue-green rollout strategy configuration. Mutually exclusive with canary and rolling.

rolling.description: Rolling rollout strategy configuration. Mutually exclusive with canary and blueGreen.

metrics.description: Optional metric gates evaluated after each step's soak. Canary only; rejected on rolling and blue-green rollouts.

finalSourceReplicas.description: Optional final replica count for the source deployment. Defaults to 0, which drains and stops the source.

finalTargetReplicas.description: Optional target replica floor at completion. Must be at least 1 when set; defaults to the source deployment's replica count at create time, or to the source and target deployments' combined replica count when both already stand in the endpoint traffic split after a cancel. If this exceeds the target autoscaling max, the rollout raises that max once when first needed unless an operator changes max mid-run; the raised ceiling remains after completion. A pre-existing target whose own autoscaling min is higher keeps that floor, reported as FINAL_BELOW_INHERITED_MIN. A target that starts stopped lands exactly at this value; if the source min was higher, PreviewRolloutDefaults reports FINAL_BELOW_SOURCE_MIN.

DE.BlueGreenConfig.description: Blue-green strategy configuration for a single cutover to the target deployment.

DE.RollingConfig.description: Rolling strategy configuration for capacity-preserving batches that ramp target replicas up while draining source replicas.

DE.CanaryConfig.description: Canary strategy configuration for gradual traffic progression. An empty config uses the default 5, 25, 50, 100 percent ladder; over a frozen traffic-split pair left by cancel, the default ladder is derived at start from the pair's current served share so it begins above it.

steps.description: Optional progression steps. Defaults to 5, 25, 50, 100 percent when empty; explicit steps must increase and end at 100 percent.

stepInterval.description: Optional positive soak between steps. Defaults to 3m if omitted, and grows to cover metric rule windows plus ingestion lag.

DE.RolloutStep.description: One stage of a canary rollout progression.

traffic.description: Required percentage of traffic on the target deployment for this step.

replicas.description: Optional explicit target replica count for this step.

DE.MetricRule.description: Metric gate evaluated during a rollout.

name.description: Required catalogue key for the metric to gate on. `serving_latency` is retired.

stat.description: Required aggregation used for the metric.

percentile.description: Percentile value, such as 99. Set only when stat is METRIC_STAT_TYPE_PERCENTILE.

thresholdCheck.description: Threshold evaluation criteria. Mutually exclusive with regressionCheck.

regressionCheck.description: Regression evaluation criteria. Mutually exclusive with thresholdCheck.

window.description: Optional query window for the metric. Defaults to the step soak duration.

DE.ThresholdCheck.description: Threshold criteria that fail when the target metric violates the configured bound.

target.description: Target interpreted according to `type`. Utilization uses a percentage from 0 to 100, value uses an absolute measurement, and average value uses a per-replica measurement.

percentile.description: Percentile to evaluate for latency-based metrics: `p50`, `p90`, `p95`, or `p99`.

DE.ScalingMetric.description: Metric and target used by the autoscaler to recommend a replica count.

deploymentId.description: ID of the deployment summarized by these metrics.

endpointId.description: ID of the deployment's parent endpoint.

timeRange.description: Closed-open time range covered by the metrics.

latencyMetrics.description: Time-to-first-token, end-to-end, and inter-token latency percentiles.

errorMetrics.description: Error rate and counts by error type.

resourceUtilization.description: Average CPU, GPU, memory, and network utilization.

tokenMetrics.description: Input and output token totals and averages.

DE.DeploymentMetrics.description: Operational metrics for one deployment under an endpoint.

errorsByType.description: Counts of errors keyed by error type (e.g. HTTP status code or error kind).

DE.ErrorMetrics.description: Error rate and aggregate counts by error type. Individual error samples are not included.

ttftP50Ms.description: 50th-percentile time to first token, in milliseconds.

ttftP90Ms.description: 90th-percentile time to first token, in milliseconds.

ttftP99Ms.description: 99th-percentile time to first token, in milliseconds.

DE.LatencyMetrics.description: Time-to-first-token, end-to-end, and inter-token latency percentiles in milliseconds.

totalRequests.description: Total requests received during the time range.

successfulRequests.description: Requests completed successfully during the time range.

failedRequests.description: Requests that failed during the time range.

requestsPerSecond.description: Average requests per second over the time range.

requestsByStatusCode.description: Request counts keyed by HTTP status code.

DE.RequestMetrics.description: Request counts, rate, and status-code distribution over a time range.

cpuUtilization.description: Average CPU utilization across replicas, as a percentage.

gpuUtilization.description: Average GPU compute utilization across replicas, as a percentage.

memoryUtilization.description: Average system memory utilization across replicas, as a percentage.

gpuMemoryUtilization.description: Average GPU memory utilization across replicas, as a percentage.

networkBandwidthMbps.description: Average network throughput across replicas, in megabits per second.

DE.ResourceUtilization.description: Average compute, memory, and network utilization for replicas over a time range.

avgBatchSize.description: Average number of requests processed in each runtime batch.

avgBatchDepth.description: Average number of batches queued or in flight in the serving engine.

DE.ThroughputMetrics.description: Token, request, and batching throughput over a time range.

totalInputTokens.description: Total input tokens processed during the time range.

totalOutputTokens.description: Total output tokens generated during the time range.

DE.TokenMetrics.description: Aggregate and per-request token usage over a time range.

total.description: Total number of parameters in the model weights.

byDtype.description: Parameter counts grouped by numerical data type.

DE.ModelParameters.description: Model parameter count and precision breakdown.

dtype.description: Numerical data type, such as `float16`, `bfloat16`, or `int8`.

count.description: Number of model parameters stored with this data type.

DE.ModelDTypeCount.description: Number of model parameters stored in one numerical data type.

CreateVideoBody.title: Create video request
CreateVideoBody.description: Parameters for creating a new video generation job.

model.description: The model to be used for the video creation request.

prompt.description: Text prompt that describes the video to generate.

steps.description: The number of denoising steps the model performs during video generation. More steps typically result in higher quality output but require longer processing time.

seed.description: Seed to use in initializing the video generation.  Using the same seed allows deterministic video generation.  If not provided a random seed is generated for each request.

guidance_scale.description: Controls how closely the video generation follows your prompt. Higher values make the model adhere more strictly to your text description, while lower values allow more creative freedom. guidence_scale affects both visual content and temporal consistency.Recommended range is 6.0-10.0 for most video models. Values above 12 may cause over-guidance artifacts or unnatural motion patterns.

output_format.description: Specifies the format of the output video. Defaults to MP4.

negative_prompt.description: Similar to prompt, but specifies what to avoid instead of what to include

generate_audio.description: Whether to generate audio for the video.

media.description: Media inputs for video generation. The accepted fields depend on the model type (e.g. i2v, r2v, t2v, videoedit).

frame_images.description: Deprecated: use media.frame_images instead. Array of images to guide video generation, similar to keyframes.

reference_images.description: Deprecated: use media.reference_images instead. Unlike frame_images which constrain specific timeline positions, reference images guide the general appearance that should appear consistently across the video.

VideoStatus.description: Current lifecycle status of the video job.

input_image.description: URL path to hosted image that is used for a frame

frame.description:
Optional param to specify where to insert the frame. If this is omitted, the following heuristics are applied:
- frame_images size is one, frame is first.
- If size is two, frames are first and last.
- If size is larger, frames are first, last and evenly spaced between.

VideoMedia.description: Contains all media inputs for video generation. Accepted fields depend on the model type.

frame_images.description: Array of images to guide video generation at specific timeline positions.

frame_videos.description: Array of video clips to use as starting clips.

reference_images.description: Array of image URLs that guide the general appearance across the video.

source_video.description: Source video to edit. Accepts a URL string or an object with a "video" key.

audio_inputs.description: Array of audio inputs. Each element accepts a URL string or an object with an "audio" key.

id.description: Unique identifier for the video job.

object.description: The object type, which is always video.

model.description: The video generation model that produced the job.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the video job.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) for when the job was created.

completed_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) for when the job completed, if finished.

size.description: The resolution of the generated video.

seconds.description: Duration of the generated clip in seconds.

error.description: Error payload that explains why generation failed, if applicable.

outputs.description: Available upon completion, the outputs provides the cost charged and the hosted url to access the video

cost.description: The cost of generated video charged to the owners account.

VideoJob.title: Video job
VideoJob.description: Structured information describing a generated video job.
